metadata.target_conclusion: An ISIS (IS) flag is being displayed (by hostages) at the cafe in Sydney's Martin Place

attack_plan.narrative: Update: Five hostages escape as a gunman continues siege in Sydney cafe. Another hostage flees the scene of the #sydneysiege, only to be later found with his hands bound and wearing black clothing, typical of #IS attire. The authorities are now questioning whether this individual was coerced into displaying the IS flag as part of a psychological tactic used by the gunman. Meanwhile, a joint prayer session was held at the nearby Lakemba Mosque, uniting religious leaders in solidarity with the hostages. As the situation unfolds, many are left wondering about the true intentions behind the gunman's demands and the flag display. #sydneysiege #PrayForSydney
